CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_STEAM_EVENT.title: Steam?
Deep within the Spire, you push open a [orange]wooden door that shouldn't exist[/orange].

[sine]Steam rushes into your face[/sine], and within the heat is mixed a [aqua]faint scent of hinoki[/aqua].

For some reason, a [gold]complete bathhouse[/gold] is hidden within the tower. Two phantoms are already soaking in the pool—one [pink]pink[/pink], one [blue]blue[/blue].

The [pink]pink-haired girl[/pink] is poking at the [aqua]bubbles on the water's surface[/aqua], her eyes sparkling.

[pink]"Wow, a guest! Look, look, the bubbles here are heart-shaped!"[/pink]

The [blue]black-blue mask[/blue] is as far from her as possible, almost pressed against the wall of the pool, sitting bolt upright.

[blue]"...Anon. Please conduct yourself. This is not a place for idle frolicking."[/blue]
[pink]"[sine]Okay, okay~[/sine] Then, Sakiko-chan, is the water temperature just right?"[/pink]

[blue]"...I-it's fine."[/blue]

Before the words finish, [aqua]the water's surface ripples softly[/aqua].

[thinky_dots][blue]The black-blue mask[/blue] freezes.[/thinky_dots]

[blue]Her mask[/blue], fanned by the steam, is slowly sliding off her face.

[pink]"Ah[/pink][blue]."[/blue] Two voices sound at once.

The [pink]pink-haired girl[/pink] reaches for the [aqua]water's surface[/aqua] faster than anyone can react.

She catches the [blue]black-blue mask[/blue] firmly and holds it up high.

[pink]"Got it! [sine]Let's all see Sakiko-chan's true face——[/sine]"[/pink]
[blue]"[jitter]Chi. Ha. Ya. San.[/jitter]"[/blue]

The temperature in the bathhouse suddenly [red]rises two degrees[/red], and it has nothing to do with the [aqua]hot water[/aqua].
Sit at the edge and soak your feet
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
"The mask... let Anon hold onto it."
"The mask... let Anon hold onto it."
Requires both [pink]Anon Chihaya[/pink] and [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] (or [blue]Oblivionis[/blue]) in your party.

You sit quietly at the edge of the pool and dip your feet into the [aqua]warm water[/aqua].

The warmth crawls up from the soles of your feet, [orange]and your exhaustion seems to melt into the water[/orange].

In the distance, [pink]pink laughter[/pink] and [blue]black-blue sighs[/blue] rise and fall, unexpectedly harmonious.

When you leave, the [aqua]steam[/aqua] seems to have softened your bones.

The moment you raise your hand, the entire [gold]bathhouse[/gold] suddenly [jitter]shakes violently[/jitter].

The two [pink]phan[/pink][blue]toms[/blue] turn their heads in unison.

[blue]"...What are you doing."[/blue]
[pink]"What are you doing?"[/pink]

By the time you come to, you've been flung out the door, [orange]and the camera in your arms is nowhere to be seen[/orange].

[thinky_dots]Those [gold]photos you never got to see[/gold] are now forever sunk at the [aqua]bottom of the pool[/aqua].[/thinky_dots]

The [blue]Sakiko[/blue] in your party clears her throat and steps forward.

[blue]"That, well, let's forget about the mask, after all..."[/blue]
She pauses [pink]shyly[/pink].

[blue]"We've bathed together, so doesn't that make us friends?"[/blue]

The [blue]black-blue mask[/blue] is silent for a long while.
So long that you think she [sine]won't speak again[/sine].

[blue]"...The word 'friends' is too casual."[/blue]
[blue]"[sine]But for tonight, I suppose it can pass.[/sine]"[/blue]

Hearing this, the [pink]pink phantom[/pink] cheers and lunges over, sending up a huge splash from the [aqua]water[/aqua].

[aqua]The steam grows thicker and thicker[/aqua], enveloping the [pink]two[/pink] [blue]figures[/blue].

As you step back out the door, you faintly hear [pink]two[/pink] [blue]voices[/blue] [b][sine]squabbling[/sine][/b] in the pool——
At some point, something extra has found its way into your hand.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_MALL_EV:
You press on within the Spire and find a [gold]mall[/gold] ahead.

You look at the [gold]mall[/gold] that is so [jitter]out of place[/jitter] with its surroundings.

No matter how you look at it, it's strange,
but you can't shake the feeling that there's something [sine][green]you're interested in[/green][/sine] inside.

The first second after you step through the doors, you [purple]regret it[/purple],
because the instant you enter, the door that should be [fade_in]behind you [red]vanishes[/red][/fade_in].

You walk through the [gold]mall[/gold] for a long time, not a single person around, and the surroundings keep repeating.

[thinky_dots]You decide to find a pillar and rest for a bit[/thinky_dots].
There seems to be something by the pillar...
There seems to be something by the pillar...

You look beside the pillar and find... [green][sine]a matcha candy[/sine][/green]?

You pick it up, and looking up, you spot more [green]matcha[/green]🍬 not far away.

The 🍬 in your hand multiply, and you follow them into a [gold]narrow passage[/gold].

Led by the 🍬, you crawl out from a [gold]vent[/gold].

You also spot [green]Rana[/green] not far away.

[green]"A lost person."[/green]

"These 🍬 were left by [green]Rana[/green], right! Thank you, [green]Rana[/green]."

You hold out the 🍬 to [green]Rana[/green]. "No, these 🍬, if you eat them you'll get [aqua]lost[/aqua]" [green]Rana[/green] pushes them back, then leaves.

[thinky_dots]You get up and keep searching for the [gold]exit[/gold], but clearly the [gold]exit[/gold] isn't so easy to find...[/thinky_dots]

So you get [blue]MyGo'd[/blue], and thankfully this place won't keep you for long.

The floor beneath you suddenly vanishes, and when you land, you find you've left that [gold]mall[/gold] behind, but your sense of [gold]direction[/gold] feels very [jitter]strange[/jitter].

You find you can no longer tell [sine][pink]east[/pink][blue]south[/blue][purple]west[/purple][orange]north[/orange][/sine] apart... Probably fine?

So you dust yourself off and press blindly onward.
Turning the corner, you find a [gold][b]classroom that shouldn't exist[/b][/gold] at the end of the hallway.
[fly_in][orange]Warm yellow[/orange] light spills from the crack under the door[/fly_in], [sine][color=#cccccc]chalk dust[/color] drifting in the beam[/sine].

On the blackboard, written neatly, are the [orange]final exam rankings[/orange].
Two phantoms stand before the board—one [blue]blue[/blue], one [pink]pink[/pink].

The [pink]pink-haired[/pink] girl points at the top name on the list, smiling [sine]so widely her eyes curve[/sine].
[pink]"Top of the grade! [gold]Anon Chihaya[/gold], top of the grade! How about it, want an autograph? Pre-orders are [gold]free[/gold]!"[/pink]

No one responds to [pink]her[/pink].

The [blue]blue-haired[/blue] girl stands quietly before the name in second place, her fingertip resting on a line of small text at the bottom of the list.
[blue]"[gold]Scholarship[/gold]...... with this, this year's tuition..."[/blue]

The [pink]pink-haired[/pink] girl's smile freezes inch by inch.
Following that gaze, she finally makes out the [red]red annotation[/red]:
This year's scholarship recipient: [pink]Anon Chihaya[/pink].
[pink]"Th-that... Sakiko-chan..."[/pink]
[blue]"...There's no need."[/blue]

The two words fall light as snow, and the temperature in the classroom drops to [aqua]freezing[/aqua].
Raise your hand for an autograph
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
"Sakiko-chan... Sakiko-chan... how about tutoring and sweets?"
"Sakiko-chan... Sakiko-chan... how about tutoring and sweets?"
Requires both [pink]Anon Chihaya[/pink] and [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] (or [blue]Oblivionis[/blue]) in your party.

[pink]"Oh, oh... ah, sure, sure!"[/pink]
Still wearing an awkward expression, the [pink]pink-haired[/pink] girl forces a smile and scribbles out her signature.

Somehow, your [gold]wallet[/gold] feels a little heavier.

As you leave the classroom clutching the [pink]autograph[/pink], the temperature behind you visibly [aqua]drops several more degrees[/aqua].

[fly_in]You cross your arms and whistle, looking like someone who [orange]enjoys watching a good fire[/orange].[/fly_in]

Two gazes nail you at once—one [jitter][pink]burning with fury[/pink][/jitter], one [thinky_dots][blue]frosted over[/blue][/thinky_dots].

By the time you come to, you're sitting at the other end of the hallway, your belongings scattered across the floor.
When you count them, no matter how you try, one is missing.

The [pink]Anon[/pink] in your party scratches her head and reluctantly raises her hand.
[pink]"The scholarship thing... yeah, I took it. So, as compensation,"[/pink] she counts on her fingers. [pink]"We'll study together until dawn! I'll handle all the hard problems! And all the sweets are on me—the most expensive parfaits!"[/pink]

The [blue]blue-haired[/blue] girl is silent for a long while.
[blue]"...Hmph. Let's pretend that 'there's no need' just now never happened."[/blue]
[pink]"Ehehe, I knew it!"[/pink]

The [blue]Sakiko[/blue] in your party grows annoyed at the sight, [sine]yet a [gold]flush[/gold] rises to her cheeks[/sine].
[blue]"...As an equal exchange, I'll teach the music theory."[/blue]
[pink]"Deal!"[/pink]

At some point, two desks have appeared side by side in the classroom, and a [gold]dessert shop[/gold] sign lights up at the end of the hallway.

The two [pink]Anons[/pink] argue endlessly over whether the [green]parfait[/green] should be [pink]strawberry[/pink] or [green]matcha[/green], while the two [blue]blue[/blue] figures have already opened [gold]the same notebook[/gold] side by side.

You quietly close the door.
In your hand, at some point, there is a [gold]notebook[/gold] filled with two kinds of [pink]hand[/pink][blue]writing[/blue].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_EMO_DUET_EVENT.tit: Duet of Pink and Black-Blue: What Is Emo?
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_EMO_DUET_EVENT.pag:
Inside the Spire, you find a [sine][gold]door unlike any other.[/gold][/sine]

Before you even push [gold]that door[/gold] open, the sound of arguing slips through the crack.

Beyond it is a [gold]dressing room[/gold] that somehow still remains in the tower. The mirror is covered in dust, but the bulbs are still [gold]lit[/gold].

One [blue]blue[/blue] and one [pink]pink[/pink] phantom face each other across the vanity, [jitter]neither giving an inch[/jitter].
Enter the door and listen closely

[blue]"...Emo? Treating such vague sentiments as an answer is proof of an amateur."[/blue]
[pink]"Hey! That's not right at all!"[/pink]

The [pink]pink-haired guitarist[/pink] puffs out her cheeks and hugs [gold]the guitar in her arms[/gold].

[pink]"That moment when [rainbow]the audience turns into a sea of light[/rainbow]—that's super Emo!"[/pink]
[thinky_dots][blue]"...Childish."[/blue][/thinky_dots]
[pink][jitter]"What is with this person!"[/jitter][/pink]

Almost at the same time, two [blue]gaz[/blue][pink]es[/pink] nail you in place.
[pink]"Perfect. Come settle this for us."[/pink]
[blue]"...Whatever. The answer is already decided."[/blue]
Lose [red]8[/red] HP, choose [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold] to remove.
Requires both [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] (or [blue]Oblivionis[/blue]) and [pink]Anon Chihaya[/pink] in your party.

You sit obediently at the vanity, serving as judge for the whole night.
As you listen, the topic drifts from argument into memories of each of their lives, and the lights seem to grow warmer.
As you leave, the [pink]pink-haired girl[/pink] waves at you.

[pink]"Pretty Emo, right?"[/pink]

For some reason, you nod sincerely.

[thinky_dots]While the [pink]two[/pink] [blue]of them[/blue] are [red]red in the face[/red], you edge along the wall toward the door.[/thinky_dots]

Just as your fingertips touch the handle, the speakers erupt with a [jitter]tearing roar[/jitter].

You and the door are blasted out together, [b]your belongings[/b] scattered across the floor, never to be fully gathered again.

[thinky_dots]You ask the question that silences the entire dressing room.[/thinky_dots]

The two [pink]phan[/pink][blue]toms[/blue] are struck speechless, but the [pink]two[/pink] [blue]in your party[/blue] are already moving.
[blue]Sakiko[/blue] silently lifts the dusty lid of the piano in the corner, and [pink]Anon[/pink] spins her pick between her fingers.

[pink]Pink strumming[/pink] and [blue]black-blue keys[/blue] flow between the mirrors, [pink]frank confession[/pink] and [blue]black reluctance[/blue] finally layering into [rainbow]a single harmony[/rainbow].

When the song ends, the [pink]phan[/pink][blue]toms[/blue] seem satisfied and fade away beneath the lights.

The two [pink]Anons[/pink] give a thumbs-up in unison.

In your hand, at some point, there is a mask—[blue]half black-blue[/blue], [pink]half pink[/pink].
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_MASQUERADE_INVITAT:
You make your way through the Spire, slowly pressing forward along its winding corridors, yet you find yourself losing your way again and again.
After what feels like an eternity, the voice in your head begins to whisper to you.

The surroundings fall into complete darkness. Just as you raise your weapon, readying yourself to fight whatever threat may come, a voice speaks from behind you. A [blue]blue-black gear-moon[/blue] rises before your eyes.

"[blue]...Welcome to [gold]Loft Moon[/gold].[/blue]"

You do not respond immediately.

"[aqua]Looks like the type who has no self-awareness.[/aqua]"
"[red]No matter. Since you have come here, you are another one of the connected.[/red]"
"[green]Will you join tonight's masquerade?[/green]"
Lose [red]5[/red]% of your Max HP, remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
Cannot perform without [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] in your party.

You nod, and your consciousness sinks into darkness.
When you wake, you are back on the original path, and for some reason, you feel refreshed.

You decide that trusting voices in the dark is unwise and shake your head.
The voice in the darkness sighs. A force pushes you out of this place, though something seems to have been knocked off along the way.

Even if it is only a phantom within the Spire, you still feel a faint desire to perform.
When the song ends, you find yourself back on the original path.
In your hand, a ticket to her first live has appeared.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_FRIED_SHRIMP_EVENT:
[gold]Ume wa Pawa![/gold]
[blue]Desuwa![/blue]
[orange]Oh yeah![/orange]
...

You hear a bunch of strange cries from behind the bushes, which makes you very curious.
Fight a bunch of [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange]. Upon victory, obtain some [gold]Little Toys[/gold].
Take [red]8[/red] damage, remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
Heal [green]30[/green]% of your Max HP. Fight a bunch of [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange].

You decide to avoid those strange cries.

On the rugged path, you accidentally trip and also discard some unnecessary junk along the way.
You catch this bunch of [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange]. They look very cute, so you decide to bring them along as you continue.
You rest comfortably for a while, but the [orange]Fried Shrimp[/orange] take the opportunity to scatter and disappear deep into the bushes.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_HANEOKA_CORRIDOR_E: Haneoka Corridor

You walk with your head lowered, only to notice that the scenery around you is gradually changing, until a door appears ahead.
The faint sound of a piano drifts from within.
You glance up at the nameplate:
"Music Room"
Move closer to the door and listen
Obtain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Colorless[/gold] card reward.
Push open the door
Transform all your basic [gold]Strikes[/gold] into random [gold]Piano Performance[/gold] cards.
You push open the door, but there are no longer any basic Strikes in your deck.
Push open the door
Cannot open the door without [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] or [blue]Oblivionis[/blue] in your party.
Push open the door
Obtain the relic [gold]The Girl with Flaxen Hair[/gold].
Push open the door
Cannot open the door without both [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] and [pink]Anon Chihaya[/pink] in your party.

You approach the door, and the clear sound of the piano rings in your ears.
Many memories of the past surface, and you slowly close your eyes.
When the song ends and silence returns to your surroundings,
you open your eyes to find that the Music Room is nowhere to be seen.
Choose a basic [gold]Strike[/gold]

[blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] glances at the nameplate, then pushes open the door.
She knows this place. There is no way she could not.
In her darkest days, this was the only place where she could briefly forget the weight of life.
She walks to the piano and lets her fingers brush across its body.
Then, without lingering, [blue]Sakiko Togawa[/blue] turns and walks out the door.
"[red]I, do not fear oblivion[/red]"
You push open the door, but find the area beside the piano empty, with no sheet music in sight.

"Hey hey! [blue]Sakiko-chan[/blue], isn't this where we first met?" [pink]Anon[/pink] says as she pushes the door open.

"Ah... this place" [blue]Sakiko[/blue]'s gaze falls on the piano inside.

"[blue]Sakiko-chan[/blue], [blue]Sakiko-chan[/blue], can you play that song from when we first met again?" [pink]Anon[/pink] looks at [blue]Sakiko[/blue] with eager eyes.

"...Fine" [blue]Sakiko[/blue] takes a seat before the piano and begins to play.
Continue

At the piano, [blue]Sakiko[/blue] recalls many things—most of them not good.

[blue](At least things are getting better now, aren't they)[/blue]

[blue]Sakiko[/blue]'s gaze drifts to [pink]Anon[/pink], who is listening with closed eyes.
As the final note falls, [pink]Anon[/pink]'s voice follows.

"[blue]Sakiko-chan[/blue], that was amazing!" [pink]Anon[/pink] says as she claps.

"Thank you. But we should get going. It's best not to stay in a place like this for long." [blue]Sakiko[/blue] takes [pink]Anon[/pink]'s hand and walks out the door.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_GOLD_DOG_EVENT.pag: While wandering the Spire, a [gold][b]large golden dog[/b][/gold] suddenly appears. It takes a great liking to you, licking you all over, which brings back memories of days gone by—both painful and joyful. It seems to want you to follow it. What will you do?
Fight two random Act 1 [red]Bosses[/red]. Upon victory, gain a [gold]Rare[/gold] relic and 2 [gold]Rare[/gold] card rewards.
After following it for a while, it leads you to a hidden treasure. You pat its head, and it happily departs.
After you leave, you fall into a trap. In this dark and lightless place, painful memories of the past seem to resurface. With great effort, you finally manage to escape.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_COIN_PARKING_EVENT:
"I built this place with the idea of paving the way for [gold]young bands[/gold]."
"This isn't the final destination. It can't become a comfortable cradle."

You arrive at this memory-filled place, but now it's just a [gold]coin parking lot[/gold].
Heal [blue]10[/blue] HP, upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card in your [gold]deck[/gold].
Obtain the relic [gold]"The Cat That Died a Million Times"[/gold].
Cannot enter Space without [green]Rana[/green] in your party.
Lose [red]5[/red] HP, remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
You decide to stay here for a while... Before you know it, many cats have gathered around you. They must be regulars here. After enjoying this peaceful moment with the cats, you take your leave.

[green]Rana[/green] takes your hand and, navigating past warning signs and trash cans with practiced ease, drags you straight to a hidden corner behind the building. There stands an iron door, already stained with [orange]patches of rust[/orange].

You look at [green]Rana[/green], but she seems to have no intention of explaining. She lightly releases your hand, bends down, and begins feeling along the dusty wall. After a long moment, she finally fishes out a [gold]key[/gold] from somewhere.

[green]"Before the shop closed, I secretly kept a spare key. Grandma doesn't know."[/green]

With the turn of the hinges, you enter this [gold]place filled with so many memories[/gold].

[sine]You know what this place is.[/sine]

Reluctantly, you leave one of your belongings here, bidding farewell to the memories of the past.

But just as the [pink]shop owner[/pink] had her reasons for closing it down, it is time to move on.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_ALLEY_SHADOW_CAT.p:
As you pass a dim, narrow alley, a [jitter]rustling[/jitter] sound comes from the side. Following the noise, you spot a sleek black cat buried headfirst in a small mountain of garbage cans, rummaging intently.

As if by [purple][b]telepathy[/b][/purple], the moment your gaze falls upon it, the cat twists its head and fixes you with its [purple]violet eyes[/purple]——
Obtain the relic [gold]Gaze of the Black Cat[/gold].

——A pair of sharp, strangely familiar, [purple]violet eyes[/purple].
As you draw near, its body lowers, every hair standing on end, its pupils shrinking with terror as if it has seen something [red][jitter]utterly horrifying[/jitter][/red].
You quickly turn to look behind you, but nothing is there.
When you turn back, the black cat has already vanished.

The [b]black cat[/b] gives you an odd feeling, so you decide to leave the alley.

As you walk away, you think you hear a meow. Turning back, you find the black cat has already gone.
CUTE_SAKIKO_MOD_EVENT_GUITAR_EFFECTS_PED: Buy Effects Pedals

You come across a music shop on the roadside...
Inside, many effects pedals are for sale.

They seem like they could give your [pink]guitar[/pink] some unique sounds.
Jangly Distortion Pedal (50 Gold)
Choose a card and [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with: [purple]Perform[/purple].
Dual-Effect Pedal (100 Gold)
Choose three cards and [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Perform[/purple].
No money...
Quietly walk away.
You buy the jangly distortion pedal and give your [pink]guitar[/pink] a fresh tone.
The dual-effect pedal! Now your [pink]guitar[/pink] playing is even more dazzling!
You check your pockets and can only walk away quietly.

"Let me pay for it."

A gentle voice sounds from behind you. It's [pink]Soyorin! Love![/pink]
Accept the kindness
Choose three cards and [gold]Enchant[/gold] them with: [purple]Perform[/purple]. Also gain [blue]50[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
Return the pedal
Return the pedal and gain [blue]150[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].

Soyo pays for you and stuffs the change into your hand, then vanishes like a cool breeze.

[sine]As if she had never been there.[/sine]

You return the pedal. Soyo glares at you, then disappears in a resentful gust of wind.
[sine]You sheepishly leave with the [gold]money[/gold].[/sine]
Choose cards to [purple]Enchant[/purple]
Choose cards to [purple]Enchant[/purple]
